name: Ocepesuchus
sum: Ocepesuchus is a gavialoid crocodylian from the Maastrichtian phosphates of Morocco, the oldest known African crocodylian.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One specimen from the Maastrichtian of Morocco.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
